latest_release.body:
## TL;DR
This release is mostly about polish and reliability: a long tail of fixes across NFC, storage and the rest of the system, plus a few new additions.

### New capabilities

- **Sub-GHz**: Added two new protocols (Elplast and Cardin S449 KeeLoq), plus FSK12Kdev modulation
- **NFC**: Added a plugin that identifies some hotel card systems
- **HID & BadUSB**: Added a Japanese keyboard layout

### Other changes

- **NFC**: Fixed crashes and buffer-overflows, optimized MIFARE Classic SEN key recovery, and sped up startup from Favorites
- **System & Storage**: Hardened security checks, fixed a false SD card event at boot, and made file copying more reliable
- **LF RFID**: More complete FDX-B info; fixed Wiegand parity and ID parsing
- **Infrared**: Fixed decoder timings and an off-by-one in a bounds check
- **HID & BadUSB**: Improved keyboard LED state reporting and raised HID report limits for international keyboards
- **JavaScript**: Added UTF-8 support for file uploads and validation for timer intervals
- **Docs**: Updated the[ Contribution Guide](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md); added [testing guides](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/b487cfdfc5a16bcb9f7e92f85592f61ead12a37f/documentation/testing/integration_tests.md), along with beginner-friendly [C/C++ App Development guides](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen/applications.html)
- **CLI**: Consistent handling of quoted paths
- **API & CCID**: New public APIs (canvas_buffer and view_port_send_to_back), plus helpers for renaming variable items and checking view dispatcher IDs; a date/time input module; and CCID interrupt transfers
- **Tooling**: clangd setup, new VSCode fbt format/clear tasks, and CI tidy-up.

## What's Changed
* docs: contribution guide update, new testing and discussion guidelines pages by @alexeyzakh in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4391
* Docs: Fix links and other stuff by @turbospok in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4396
* Add date/time input module by @aaronjamt in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4261
* Storage: Dont send mount event if SD mounted at boot by @WillyJL in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4290
* VSCode tasks add fbt format and clear commands by @xMasterX in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4302
* docs: adjusted formatting in README Flipper Zero Firmware section by @egenuise in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4308
* Fix: Use actual spaces instead of empty buffer by @xMasterX in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4397
* CI: Disable automatic merge report workflow by @iMalkav in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4398
* Make FDX-B readout more descriptive by @snowsign in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4297
* SubGHz: Add Elplast protocol by @xMasterX in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4309
* NFC: Make NFC app startup from fav's faster by @xMasterX in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4313
* Improve some documentation in the `view_dispatcher` and `view_port` by @loftyinclination in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4318
* Clangd: Add clangd parameters in IDE agnostic config file by @WillyJL in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4319
* SubGHz: Add FSK12Kdev modulation and Cardin S449 Keeloq support by @xMasterX in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4328
* Update js_gui.md to reflect firmware 1.4 changes and fix a typo by @alexeyzakh in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4329
* NFC: Fix sending 32+ byte ISO 15693-3 commands by @WillyJL in https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pull/4333
* NFC: ISO 15693-3
